name: sidx_drift_v1_vista
purpose: Attack B v1 smoke + perf probe: drift-aware SIDX refresh in gpu_step_sidx_invalidate. Tracks new STEP_PHASES counters sidx_drift_hits/misses/leaked_tiles/sidx_drift_check + the existing density_sidx_prebuild bucket. 12-min walltime to hit ~80+ steps spanning multiple domain decomps. Pass criteria: no segfaults; tiny-N density_sidx_prebuild bucket collapses from ~1.30s to <0.05s when fast-path hits; sidx_drift_hits dominates over misses on non-decomp steps.
